From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sparkbank.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: security@sparkbank.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: CAIQ: initial control pack / evidence asks

Hi Logan,

We're kicking off SparkBank's CAIQ intake for the platform-approval committee and need a compact control pack from Redwood for our security review. Can you help with the following by next Friday (10/09)?

- A CAIQ-to-control mapping spreadsheet (controls + your suggested artifacts)
- Owner attestation templates for 30 controls marked as in-scope (we'll ask for signatures)
- Representative log samples for runtime isolation (P1 controls: network segmentation, tenant isolation, KMS access)
- Evidence of key rotation / KMS config and a short note on HSM usage (if applicable)

We prefer a scoped delivery first (critical controls) and then a second tranche for lower-risk items. Also please call out anything that will need redaction before we can accept artifacts (PII, customer IDs).

Can we schedule a 30-min sync next week to walk the mapping? Thanks — Elena

Elena Ruiz
Head of Cloud Assurance, SparkBank
elena.ruiz@sparkbank.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
